fields.Name: User Routine Dispatcher
fields.Description: Sweeps MJ: User Routines for due routines (Status=Active, inside the StartAt/EndAt activation window, NextRunAt passed) and executes each one's target — Agent, Action, or Prompt — with bounded concurrency and per-routine error isolation. Each execution is recorded in MJ: User Routine Runs (telemetry lives on the linked Agent Run / Prompt Run / Action Execution Log), the routine's LastRunAt/LastRunStatus/LastResultHash are updated, and the owner + recipients are notified per the routine's NotifyCondition (Always / OnSuccess / OnFailure / OnChange via result hashing) through the MJ template + notification stack. Routines with a NULL NextRunAt are seeded (next occurrence computed) without running. Optional Configuration: { "MaxConcurrentRoutines": <number> } (default 3).
